title: Sethosis
summary: Sethosis is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.date: “Sethosis, who was called also Aegyptus, as was his brother Armais known by the name of Danaus”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 130; Manetho, ap. Josephus, Against Apion, book 1
reign.note: No reign length is printed for Sethosis. The edition prints the name as Aegyptus (the scan's capital is Æ). Attached also to danaus because this sentence names him. Not merged with Danaus.
